lead: K. A. Sengottaiyan is a widely followed Indian politician, born on 9 January 1948 in Kullampalayam.
As of 2026, he is 78 years old, and his birth date places him under the Capricorn sign.
He has held the office of Member of the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly and Member of the 16th Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly.
